title: Colca Canyon Trek 2 Days / 1 Night
short_description: Experience a two-day trek through Colca Canyon, visiting traditional villages, Sangalle and the famous Condor Cross viewpoint.
long_description: Discover magnificent Colca Canyon on a 2-day, 1-night trek from Arequipa. Cross San Juan de Chuccho, Cosñirhua, Malata and the Sangalle oasis while combining hiking, local communities, hot springs and the Condor Cross viewpoint.
price_note: Price per person. Ask about rates and availability.

days.title: Day 1: Arequipa – Condor Cross – Sangalle
days.lugar: Arequipa → Chivay → Condor Cross → San Juan de Chuccho → Sangalle
days.text: Pickup between 3:00 and 3:30 a.m. and travel to Chivay for breakfast. Visit Condor Cross, then begin an approximately three-hour descent from San Miguel to San Juan de Chuccho. After lunch, cross Cosñirhua and Malata to Sangalle for a pool, dinner and an overnight stay in rustic bungalows.

days.title: Day 2: Sangalle – Cabanaconde – Chivay – Arequipa
days.text: Begin around 5:00 a.m. with a three-hour ascent to Cabanaconde. After breakfast, visit hot springs and continue to Chivay. Lunch is optional and arrival in Arequipa is expected around 5:00 p.m.

antes_de_viajar: Be physically prepared for several hours of hiking
